knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Contamination of a recycling stream by one wrong item is the reason for keeping the streams apart.
The site guide or site contact decides. Default to general waste when unsure, rather than guessing.
An item the guide does not accept for recycling goes to general waste. Recycling bags are not used as a holding place.

practicalCriteria: Sets up both streams and checks the bin labels against the site guide before the route starts.
Sorts a sample set of desk items into the correct stream, defaulting to general waste for unclear items.
Ties and labels recycling bags and delivers each bag to its designated point.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80% pass mark, which for three questions means all three correct. Practical sign-off is separate and observed by an assessor.
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation of sorting a sample set
stopWorkCriteria: Both streams placed in one bag
Unclear items placed in recycling without checking the site guide
